posts.title: The legacy of upcloudbgpwhen.de
posts.description: For the last year, I was running a small fediverse bot that sent a daily message, asking UpCloud to start offering BGP sessions to their customers. Yesterday marked the end of this little bot, as I let the domain expire and thus set an end to this fun, little afternoon project.
